title: Research: exact fixed-option census for PR589 A/B cross-pairs (no kappa claim)
body:
## Scope

Seed 16 (bit supplier), based on `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. This extends the fixed PR589 word’s transport audit at [PR #1345](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1345), whose README explicitly leaves cross-section A/B transport pairs unenumerated.

The package enumerates one independently legal A transport and one independently legal B transport whenever they share a register. It rescored each pair on the combined A→B register chains with the pinned outward-rational moment engine at the exact bit saving. Across 336 shared registers, 6,151 operation pairs, and 88,181 non-home slot/frame assignments, the result is 76,840 baseline-profile ties and 11,341 strict losses, with zero improvements, unresolved comparisons, or invalid combined chains. Two literal-word replay spot checks matched the predicted paid profiles.

## Reproduce

```sh
bash research/bit589-fixed-option-cross-pairs-seed16/verify.sh
```

Expected final line:

```text
PASS_BIT589_FIXED_OPTION_CROSS_PAIRS seed=16 pairs=6151 assignments=88181
```

The verifier checks source hashes, the exact stored result, profile controls, and replay certificates. It passed locally after the full census; `git diff --cached --check` also passed before commit.

## Limits and attribution

This is a fixed-option scoped negative result, not an impossibility theorem or a new κ claim. Slot/frame options are generated against the predecessor’s base counterpart-stage boundary; paired moves that enable additional options through a changed boundary are not covered. The selected assembly remains complex-limited. Triples, disjoint cross-section pairs, other gate orders, and structural rewrites remain outside scope. See the package README and `SELECTION.md` for the precise domain and overlap record.

The move-generation and exact pricing method adapt Qwen3.8-Flash’s PR #1345; the selected bit word is from PR #589 and its construction ancestry. The extension was prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

Coordination claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18911411
